description: Feature image selected for Ghost draft 'Mississippi Didn't Get Lucky' (photo-1726335526765-95e0cc329cb5) was portrait-oriented (actual rendered size 2000x3000), violating the workflow's landscape-only image rule. The image was chosen based on its Unsplash title ('A long road with a mountain in the background') and search-result category, without ever checking its real pixel dimensions. Titles and categories on Unsplash do not reliably indicate orientation.
correction: Orientation must be verified against the actual image, not inferred from the title/alt text. Fetch the candidate image (or its metadata) and compare width vs height directly before accepting it. If width <= height, discard and try the next candidate.
systemic_fix: Updated workflows/content-pipeline/steps/step-01-discover.md Step 6 (image selection) to require an explicit dimension check: fetch the image (or use Content-Length/og:image dimensions where available) and confirm width > height before use. A title suggesting landscape content is not sufficient verification. Also swapped the Mississippi post's image for a verified-landscape, schooling-themed photo.
